figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0) SELECT supplier_id,bucket,COUNT(*) invoices,SUM(balance_cents) outstanding_cents FROM a GROUP BY supplier_id,bucket ORDER BY outstanding_cents DESC

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 来源
parts.note: 数据来自中间结果 a。

parts.label: 分组
parts.note: 按 supplier_id,bucket 把行归入各个分组。

parts.label: 排序
parts.note: 按 outstanding_cents DESC 排列结果。
